color.$description:
The semantic colour layer for the light theme.

Semantic colour lives in the theme files rather than in semantic/, because every semantic colour is theme-dependent by definition — there is no theme-neutral value for `color.canvas`. Splitting it into a semantic file plus per-theme overrides would mean writing each name twice and inventing precedence rules. Instead each theme states the whole colour contract once. The token build enforces that every theme defines exactly the same set of names, so the two files cannot drift.

canvas.$description: The page behind everything. Never put text directly on it without a surface.

surface.$description: Default raised content surface: cards, panels, sheets.

surfaceRaised.$description: A surface above another surface. In the light theme elevation reads through shadow, so this matches `surface`; in the dark theme it steps lighter instead.

surfaceSunken.$description: A contextual 3% recessed fill inside a surface: code blocks, inset lists, and track backgrounds.

backgroundMaterialUltraThin.$description: Lowest-tint translucent material. Pair with blur.backgroundMaterial.ultraThin.

backgroundMaterialThin.$description: Translucent tint for compact chrome and lightly separated background material. Pair with blur.backgroundMaterial.thin.

backgroundMaterialRegular.$description: Default translucent tint for panels and floating controls. Pair with blur.backgroundMaterial.regular.

backgroundMaterialThick.$description: High-opacity tint for sheets and content-bearing overlays. Pair with blur.backgroundMaterial.thick.

backgroundMaterialUltraThick.$description: Highest-tint translucent material. Pair with blur.backgroundMaterial.ultraThick.

backgroundMaterialHighlight.$description: Renderer-isolated highlight for color-dodge treatment on a material background.

backgroundMaterialShadow.$description: Thirteen-percent elevation shadow for floating material backgrounds.

labelSource.$description: Black foreground source from which adaptive opaque label tiers are composed.

text.$description: Primary body and heading text, expressed as black at the primary semantic label strength.

textMuted.$description: Secondary text: captions, help text, metadata. The translucent source lets the containing surface participate in the result.

textDisabled.$description: Tertiary-strength text for disabled controls. Deliberately low contrast; disabled content is exempt and the hierarchy is the affordance.

border.$description: Default component boundary, derived from the same opacity-based fill system as separators.

borderStrong.$description: Emphasised component boundary: hovered controls and active field borders.

focusRing.$description: Keyboard focus indicator. Paired with border.focusRing / border.focusRingOffset.

shadow.$description: Elevation shadow colour. Components own the shadow's geometry; the theme owns its colour, because how much a shadow reads depends entirely on what it sits on.

overlay.$description: Translucent backdrop behind dialogs, drawers, menus, and other elevated surfaces.

action.$description: The accent tone. Primary buttons, links, selected state.

actionWash.$description: Lowest-emphasis action-tinted surface for provenance and preview scaffolding.

onAction.$description: Ink foreground for content sitting on `action`; the Paper primary blue does not carry white text at accessible body sizes.

neutral.$description: Idle neutral control fill, composed as 5% black over its actual light surface.

positive.$description: The positive tone. Success, confirmation, safe-to-proceed.

warning.$description: The warning tone. Needs attention but is not an error.

onWarning.$description: Dark rather than light: amber is too bright to carry white text at 4.5:1.

critical.$description: The critical tone. Errors and destructive actions.

opacity.$description: Adaptive semantic label strengths for the light theme. Renderers combine these values with color.labelSource instead of treating every tier as an unrelated grey.
